text:
Emily: Heads-up—microsite cutover for the marketplace listing is scheduled today at 17:00 PT. This thread to track press ops + traffic mapping. @Mike can you confirm CDN purge window?
Mike: Confirmed. Purge + cache-priming 16:50–17:10 PT. Will use low-TTL staging flag. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Press embargo still holds until 17:05 PT, right? We should keep the embargo lift in sync with cutover so search previews don't leak.
Emily: Yes embargo lift at 17:05 PT. Press ops will publish the release at 17:06 PT. We'll coordinate a 1-min buffer after cutover completes.
Luke: Quick ops notes: DNS TTL has been lowered to 60s on the A-records for the microsite domain. I’ll monitor propagation. If anything weird, we can failover to the old bucket via route53 alias.
Rachel: SI partners have a standby webhook test running. They passed smoke at 14:20. I’ll ping the SI oncall 10m before cutover to confirm readiness.
Mike: Adding the traffic mapping we agreed on: 30% -> variant-a (cdn-edge1), 70% -> variant-b (cdn-edge2) for first 15m, then 100% to variant-b. Can we automate the ramp?
Emily: Yes, we’ll use the rollout script. Paste below the command we’ll run:
```
# rollout script snippet
./traffic-rollout --domain marketplace.example.com --weights 30,70 --window 15m
```
Priya: Heads-up for press: include the product note about Dedicated capacity and Private deployments — legal already signed off on the quote. I attached the one-liner in the press doc.
Mike: deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for microsite-v3 at 15:40 PT. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/7890 :rocket:
deploy-bot: production readiness checks passed (basic health, certs, route53).
Luke: I'll be watching CloudFront logs + origin errors. If 5xx spikes > 0.5% in first 10m, flip rollback flag.
Rachel: SI oncall (Tom) says they're ready for webhook retention checks at 16:55. I’ll trigger a final test then.
Emily: Final checklist before cutover (quick):
- CDN purge window set (Mike)
- DNS TTL lowered (Luke)
- Staging deploy passed (deploy-bot)
- SI webhook + retention smoke (Rachel)
- Press embargo lift timed (Priya)
- Rollout script ready (Mike)
If no objections, we execute at 17:00 PT. Say "go" in thread. :eyes:
Mike: go
Priya: go
Luke: go
Rachel: go
Emily: executing. I’ll post updates in this thread and the release channel. Good luck everyone. :party_popper:
